#### Course: Learn C++ Basics

## Function Summary(I)

### 1. Function Introduction

A function is a block of code that performs a specific task.

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2using namespace std;
3
4// function to greet
5void greet() {
6    cout << "Hello" << endl;
7    cout << "How are you?";
8}
9
10int main() {
11    return 0;
12}
```

### 2. Function Call

Defining a function won't do anything; we need to call the function to bring it into action.

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2using namespace std;
3
4// function to greet
5void greet() {
6    cout << "Hello" << endl;
7    cout << "How are you?";
8}
9
10int main() {
11
12    // function call
13    greet();
14
15    return 0;
16}
```

### 3. Arguments and Return Value

![Function can be considered as a machine that takes argument as input and gives the return value as output](data:image/png;base64,)

Arguments are inputs to the function and return value is the output from the function.

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2using namespace std;
3
4// function takes two arguments
5// returns the sum of numbers
6int add_numbers(int n1, int n2) {
7    int result = n1 + n2;
8    return result;
9}
10
11int main() {
12
13    // function call
14    int total = add_numbers(12, 36);
15    cout << total << endl;    // 48
16
17    total = add_numbers(10, 20);
18    cout << total;    // 30
19
20    return 0;
21}
```
